purpose: Adapters for newly deduplicated global microscope-slide collection entries added in 07G.
guards: Preserve dated counts and mixed-material count scopes exactly.
Do not collapse prepared by, curated by, exchanged by, provided by or catalogued by into ownership.
Prefer bounded collection/database endpoints; literature-only rows remain manual until an official endpoint is found.

adapters.promotion_rule: Extract slide-mounted count, type context, collection-database links and keep pinned/cryogenic holdings separate.
Preserve named personal collections and their counts as separate collection nodes even when they share one institutional page.

adapters.institution_scope: Bohart Museum of Entomology UC Davis
adapters.promotion_rule: Capture explicit glass-slide count, named collectors and type-material context.

adapters.institution_scope: University of Georgia Collection of Arthropods
adapters.promotion_rule: Treat historical dated counts as dated layers; do not project them as current inventory totals.
Capture named collection, slide count, type context and linked insect-database endpoint.
Capture slide-mounted component separately from whole-museum specimen totals.
Preserve the exchange rule and USw linkage as circulation/provenance evidence; do not infer a slide count.
Capture section-level preparation count, donors and type holdings; keep pinned/alcohol material separate.
Capture explicit slide existence, archaeological context and curator/project links; leave count null when unstated.
Treat donor, box structure, slide total and type-specimen statement as separate fields in one transfer event.

adapters.institution_scope: National Taiwan University School of Pharmacy
adapters.promotion_rule: Capture physical collection existence and digitisation partnership; keep vague hundreds wording rather than manufacturing an exact count.

adapters.institution_scope: Shiga University of Medical Science Medical Museum
adapters.promotion_rule: Preserve source multiplication structure as 120 sets x about 250 slides; do not silently normalize into a synthetic exact total.
Traverse bounded database hierarchy and preserve sample, locality, room-rack-drawer, storage-box and slide-board fields.

adapters.institution_scope: University of Padua Museum of Nature and Humankind
adapters.promotion_rule: Capture named historical collectors, exchange/type context and separate >400 statements without summing until overlap is resolved.
Capture wood-specimen-to-slide linkage, count and partial digital inventory/georeferencing.
Preserve subcollection counts and named collector collections separately, with type-material context.
Capture high-volume slide count, cataloguing state, documentation and future online/loan hooks.
Use literature to establish collection existence and mixed material scope; do not convert 30,000 mixed items to slide count; seek official endpoint.

adapters.institution_scope: University of Warsaw Faculty of Biology
adapters.promotion_rule: Capture institutional-name layers, relocations and label history; count remains null unless a register appears.
Use literature as collection-level evidence only; keep mixed 40,000 macro/microfossil total separate from slide subtotal.
